name: Carrion Defense Works Toxic Environment Mapping Kit TEMK-2
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Toxic Environment Mapping Kit TEMK-2
description: A portable environmental mapping system that deploys ground-level sensors to create a real-time contamination map of the surrounding area. The TEMK-2 includes 12 deployable sensor stakes that monitor air quality, soil contamination, radiation levels, and water toxicity within a 500-meter radius, transmitting data to a handheld display that generates color-coded contamination maps. The system identifies safe corridors through contaminated zones and provides real-time warnings when contamination levels change.
story_hooks: A TEMK-2 deployed in a supposedly clean Tier 2 district revealed contamination levels that exceed safety standards — the contamination source is a sealed facility that claims to produce nothing hazardous.

TEMK-2 data from multiple deployments has been compiled to create a comprehensive contamination map of lower-tier Meridian 88 — the map reveals that safe corridors between contaminated zones form a pattern that suggests deliberate boundary management.
